content:
So I switched the project to the module system by adding module, public import, and @[expose] public section to all files. It builds locally. But doing lake exe mk_all undoes the main file and imports everything privately.
Is there something that we need to do in order to properly switch to the module system?

There variant which works with the module system is
lake exe mk_all --module
Notably there is a recent change to this. After #38395 you only need --module for the initial port, after which it will be inferred.
Do we also need to update the old Github workflow (current one gives an error about lake exe mk_all failing)? Is there one out there that utilizes the module system?

Once you have ported to the module system and bumped Mathlib to include the PR I linked above, no, because it will infer that the module system is being used for a regular lake exe mk_all.

If for whatever reason bumping Mathlib immediately is an issue, you can still explicitly change the workflow to use lake exe mk_all --module.
(To answer the last bit more directly: no, lean-action does not have a way to tell it to use --module. I believe it is preferred to bump Mathlib so it's not required)
